primary_question: Can absolute kcat predictors rank enzyme candidates measured for the same substrate in the same experimental conditions?
primary_endpoint_scope: direct absolute kcat only; do not merge relative activity, fitness or catalytic efficiency
candidate_unit: fully identified enzyme construct or documented complex
ranking_unit: independently audited source-specific experimental campaign with fixed substrate, reaction direction, buffer, temperature, pH and cofactor conditions
candidate_secondary_metrics: top-k enrichment only where campaign size supports it
independence_requirements: preserve source and family dependence in uncertainty estimation
no splitting of one campaign across development and evaluation
required_before_evaluation: pass every existing external readiness gate
audit full campaign identity and measurement comparability
set sample-size and precision requirements using metadata and development-only simulations
freeze campaign inclusion, minimum size, ties, metrics, models and statistical analysis
verify no selection based on observed evaluation scores
